Entities / Characters / Nona Black Jaw

Nona Black-Jaw

SpeciesRattkin
RoleMatriarch, [[black-jaw-run
Location[[warren

Quote: “I don’t care about the Vestra, Peron. I do not care about Vincenzo’s boat. I miss him dearly, but we lost so much money on that stupid talking boat. I am glad it is at the bottom of the ocean. Now you, though — how many men must we kill to put its head on my wall?”

Overview

Nona Black-Jaw has been at war with the Dravosi Crown for nearly 40 years. Not loudly. Not with speeches. She fed the hungry, built a home for those in hiding, and has never stopped resisting.

To the Crown she is a smuggler, terrorist, and fugitive — they called her the Calveno Candle in her youth, when she was caught multiple times for ambushes on Dravosi ships, usually involving improvised incendiary devices. To the Kin of the Warren, she is the reason there’s a Warren to come home to.

She feeds people first. Not as a tactic. Because people deserve to eat.

Appearance & Manner

Very small, even by Rattkin measure. Fur almost entirely silver-white, except for the dark brown-black mask along her jaw that gives the family its name. Sharp pink-rimmed eyes; calloused paws. She sits perfectly straight, wears a flour-dusted floral apron over dark, well-made cloth. Smells of garlic and fresh bread.

She discusses Dravosi inspection schedules and burning things down in the same tone she uses for the weather. Urgency stopped impressing her decades ago. Runs the kitchen like a courtroom — she hears cases and issues rulings. Grief handled sideways: she moves the problem.

The Cheese Rule

A Black-Jaw saying: “You don’t take the cheese. You’re given it.”

It started as tradecraft — don’t be the rat in someone else’s trap. But Nona taught it to Perrin as something larger: the difference between a person the Crown has defined and a person it hasn’t. A signed release from a frightened official who accepted a pastry and apologized for the delay is cleaner than robbery, and it costs them more.

She taught it early. He’d reach for a sweet roll before dinner. She’d smack his paw with a spoon: “You don’t take the cheese.” He would sigh: “You’re given it.” Then she’d give him two.

Black-Jaw Rules

Nona’s Run commits crimes, but not all crimes:

  • Do not traffic people.
  • Do not use poison.
  • Do not betray sanctuary.
  • Do not steal from the Warren.

“If you make a coin selling someone’s chain, I break your hands, take the coin, and spend it getting them free.”

Vincenzo

Her late husband Vincenzo Black-Jaw built the Vestra and captained her for decades. His chair at family meals stays empty. Their love was passionate, complicated, and singular — with frequent arguments and four good frying pans broken over his stubborn gambler skull. She’s still a little angry at Vincenzo. He left her to run the whole thing alone, and she’s been doing it, and she misses him every single day.

Household & Guard

  • Enzo — jaguar tabaxi bodyguard. Tailored suit, polished claws, immaculate shoes.
  • Ruk — lizardfolk bodyguard. Massive, scarred, literal.
  • Anzolo — tortle enforcer and trusted fixer.

Proactive Objectives

  • The favor from Perrin — called in (Session 04): sent the party to investigate Grung sightings in the sewers.
  • Respond to the Grung bombing intelligence Felix provided — unprecedented threat to Calveno.
  • Anzolo: was sent to find Perrin before attacks called off; now recalled.

Session Events

  • Session 03: Perrin arrived in her kitchen during an open-door session. Waited for a rattkin family to leave. Heard about the Vestra. Cracked her spoon. Ordered Enzo to console the Vestra’s crew. Called off the attacks — she had feared Perrin was captured by the Tarahs after Cobb reported one of their ships in port. Asked a favor; he said yes unconditionally. Gave him a sending stone.
  • Session 04: Called in the favor via sending stone: “I need some work done. Come speak to me at the safe house. Bring your friends, especially the blue one, and anyone who can fight.” Briefed party on 6 Grung sightings in Warren tunnels and sewers — unprecedented this far north. Uneasy around Delmar‘s Dravosi appearance until he revealed his mother was Midchain and he’d “happily emptied a Dravosi ship or two.” Accepted him because the Dravosi know her by a nickname Delmar didn’t recognize. Provided Hero’s Feast through her cooking. Received Felix Aho as prisoner with full bombing intel. “I knew I chose the right people for the job.” Noted she’s never met a Grung who wasn’t a dissident besides Jean-Claude. Sent urgent response via sending stone when Perrin reported the black powder: “Oh, it’s real. No shit. I will send Enzo and more to you.”
DM Note

Nona now has actionable intelligence on a coordinated Grung bombing of Calveno — 4 attack points, 2-day deadline, festival timing. Her response will define the Passage’s role in the next session. She may break shadow protocol to warn the city, or she may try to handle it through Passage channels alone.

  • Perrin Black-Jaw — grandson; favor owed; holds the paired sending stone
  • Vincenzo Black-Jaw — late husband
  • Vestra — Vincenzo’s ship
  • Enzo, Ruk — bodyguards
  • Anzolo — enforcer
  • Beaumont Sel — passed the original message
  • The Passage — operates within
  • Black-Jaw Run — matriarch

  • The Tarahs — known threat to Rattkin in the area; Nona watches for their ships
